reader.requirement: At --std 85 SUPPRESS PRINTING must be accepted in any paragraph of a USE BEFORE REPORTING declarative section and refused anywhere else: nondeclarative procedures, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION declarative, or a nondeclarative paragraph that a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure performs.
reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition.Has/Edition.Edition over ReportWriterBinder.cs and EnclosingContext.cs; VersionConformancePass.cs has no SUPPRESS visitor; Constructs.g.cs has no SUPPRESS-statement construct (only copy-suppress and alternate-key-suppress-when); SUPPRESS and PRINTING are reserved at every edition.

reader.notes: BindSuppress asks the one bind-position probe for the enclosing declarative and refuses unless it carries a report group (a USE BEFORE REPORTING section), so every paragraph of the section qualifies and nothing outside does. No edition switch exists or is needed: the rule is unchanged in later editions. Diagnostic cites §2023:14.9.45.3 SR1 at --std 85.
